summary: Iteration 2 testing complete for Edge AI. New external integrations (The Odds API live, API-Football subscription-gated), dashboard filters/alerts/import-modal, and match history view all verified. Backend 5/5 new tests pass. Frontend confirms all new testids render and import->dedup flow works end-to-end.

issues: match-history-list testid only renders when history.length > 0; an empty-state placeholder div (without testid) renders otherwise. This is fine for UX, but tests must run >=1 analysis before asserting the testid is present.

critical_code_review_comments: external_data.fetch_odds_api_sports gracefully falls back to ODDS_SPORTS list when key missing/quota exhausted - good resilience.
_persist_imported correctly dedupes via (owner_id, external_id) lookup; verified by running import twice (10 inserted -> 10 skipped).
server.py /api/external/import/api-football wraps RuntimeError with HTTPException(502) + Polish prefix 'Błąd API-Football:' - error path is clean (verified live: 403 from RapidAPI -> 502 to client).
Dashboard import modal correctly renders both sources, league dropdown populates dynamically from /api/external/leagues, status text shows 'Pobrano N, zapisano M, pominięto duplikatów K'.
Alerts banner correctly shows 15 chips for edges >= 5%, 'Ukryj wszystkie' control present; chip click navigation and localStorage dismissal not directly automated but wired per code review.
Recharts wrappers in Stats.jsx and MatchDetail.jsx now use explicit inline width:100% height:NNN divs - no width(-1)/height(-1) console warnings captured during navigation.
match-history-list conditional render (only when history non-empty) is acceptable UX; testid still resolvable after running >=1 analysis.

success_rate.backend: 100% (5/5 new external tests + previous regressions stable)
success_rate.frontend: 95% (all new testids verified; recharts warnings cleared)

seed_data_creation: Imported 10 Brazil Série A matches via Odds API during test; second call skipped all 10 (dedup verified).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 2 backend external endpoints verified. /api/external/leagues returns 8 static api_football + dynamic odds_api list (Brazil Série A available). /api/external/import/odds-api works live; /api/external/import/api-football returns 502 with Polish 'Błąd API-Football' (RapidAPI subscription block - NOT a bug). Dashboard test selectors confirmed: dashboard-import-button, dashboard-import-submit-button, dashboard-import-league-select, dashboard-filter-search, dashboard-league-filter, dashboard-min-edge-slider, dashboard-alerts-banner. MatchDetail: match-history-list (renders only when history exists). Source choice in import modal is clickable card (not a select); use text='The Odds API' or 'API-Football'. Counter 'X / Y mecz(y)' updates live with filters.
rca of the issue: No new bugs found. The previously reported recharts width(-1) warning from iteration_1 appears resolved (no warnings captured in console during navigation across Dashboard, Stats). API-Football 502 is by design (RapidAPI subscription gating).
